69abb97005.q: What is the lifecycle of broiler chicken from hatching to harvest in Nandus supply chain?
69abb97005.a: Broiler chickens are fast-growing hybrid birds that take approximately eight weeks to reach 2.2 to 2.3 kg body weight. Nandus owns the entire supply chain: they operate the feed mill, breeding farms that produce hatching eggs, incubate the eggs to create day-old chicks, and then work with associated farmers to rear the birds to market weight using proprietary feed formulations and farming practices before harvest.

c3016fc6ee.q: How did integration farming model change the economics for chicken farmers in India?
c3016fc6ee.a: About 25 years ago, integration farming replaced the independent farmer model. Previously, farmers bought chicks and feed, grew birds, and sold them as commodities in volatile markets. Integration farming insulated farmers from price fluctuations by having companies like Nandus provide the chick, feed, technical services, and veterinary support, guaranteeing steady income throughout the year while the company handles market volatility.

21e1ae3572.q: What are the key differences between broiler chicken and country chicken in India?
21e1ae3572.a: Country chicken or nati chicken are slow-growing native breeds that take six to eight months to reach respectable weight with very lean meat and low yield. Broiler chickens, developed through selective breeding and hybridization about 60 years ago, are fast-growing birds reaching 2.1 to 2.3 kg in eight weeks. However, there is absolutely no nutritional difference between them—they come from the same gene pool.

7fb2495e9e.q: Why did Naren transition from farming to launching the Nandus consumer brand?
7fb2495e9e.a: The main driver was loss of traceability and quality control in the wet market supply chain. When selling live birds to traders who then sold to chicken shop owners, there was no control over pricing or how the product was processed and stored before reaching consumers. Additionally, he could not feed his own family with the high-quality chicken he was producing, which motivated him to start Nandus around 2016 to control both production and consumer delivery.

f6b669807e.q: What is the annual feed production capacity at Nandus and how does feed quality impact chicken quality?
f6b669807e.a: Nandus produces close to 100,000 tons of feed per annum and employs nutritionists who constantly optimize the nutritional composition for both broiler chickens and parent birds. Feed formulation is a proprietary differentiator for the company, as the quality of feed directly determines the health, nutrition, and meat quality of the bird—following the principle that garbage in produces garbage out.
